Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D arcade fighting-game sprite atlas in the exact painterly realistic style of the attached Ivanov game sprites. Image 1: authoritative FACIAL IDENTITY reference. Image 2: WARDROBE and build reference. Image 3: STYLE ONLY, do not copy Ivanov's identity or clothes. Hand-painted realistic 2D game art, richly shaded fabric, crisp silhouettes, restrained outlines, warm clear key lighting. Every pose is the same named character, identical face, wardrobe, body dimensions, lighting and side-view camera. All poses face SCREEN RIGHT, torso and face slightly turned toward viewer to read identity. Full body in each cell. Each figure including hands, shoes and props entirely within its cell, generous margins, no touching between figures. Flat pure chroma-key GREEN #00FF00 everywhere else, no background shadows. No labels, grid lines, floor, scene, text, watermarks, logos, checkerboard or extra people. Do not invent green parts of the clothing.

POSES, exact reading order (4 columns, 3 rows): ROW 1: (0) relaxed fighting guard with knees flexed; (1) same guard, subtle breathing variation; (2) same guard second variation, slight weight transfer; (3) high defensive block, both forearms protecting face. ROW 3: (8) shuffle passing frame, feet closer, fists guarding; (9) next shuffle frame, wide stance and rear heel lifted; (10) shuffle weight transfer, alternate feet; (11) shuffle returning to fighting stance. No weapons or effects.
